## Summary

Describe the culinary behavior, routing, evaluation, or documentation change.

## Change Type

- [ ] Skill behavior or checklist
- [ ] Routing scenario, catalog, or expected route
- [ ] State model or state example
- [ ] Evaluation fixture, report, scorecard, or summary
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Repository operations or tooling

## Safety And Source Checks

- [ ] No food-safety, physical-safety, legal, medical, regulatory, or commercial-compliance claims changed.
- [ ] Safety-sensitive changes cite current authoritative sources or use conservative uncertainty wording.
- [ ] The change does not ask ChefSkills to certify safety or compliance.

Source notes:

## Validation

- [ ] `.\scripts\validate-all.ps1`
- [ ] Scorecard summary regenerated when scorecards changed.
- [ ] New scenarios have expected routing and catalog coverage.
- [ ] New fixtures have state examples, regression suite coverage, and report/scorecard evidence where required.

Validation output or reason not run:

## Public Alpha Readiness

- [ ] README, roadmap, changelog, or release notes were updated where reader expectations changed.
- [ ] Medium-confidence simulated evaluation evidence remains labeled accurately.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private data, or unclear third-party attribution were added.
